head: Metformin
evidence_text: Metformin is the recommended first-line pharmacological treatment for type 2 diabetes mellitus. It reduces hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity.

head: Warfarin
evidence_text: Warfarin therapy is associated with an increased risk of major bleeding, particularly intracranial hemorrhage in elderly patients.

head: COPD
evidence_text: Patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease typically present with progressive dyspnea, chronic cough and sputum production.

head: Spironolactone
evidence_text: Spironolactone reduces morbidity and mortality in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.

head: ACE inhibitors
evidence_text: A persistent dry cough is a well recognised class effect of angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors and a common reason for discontinuation.

head: Hepatitis C
evidence_text: Direct-acting antiviral regimens achieve sustained virological response in over 95% of patients with chronic hepatitis C virus infection.

head: Aspirin
evidence_text: Low-dose aspirin increases the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding and peptic ulceration.

head: Ibuprofen
evidence_text: Ibuprofen and loop diuretics were compared for protein-bound uremic toxin clearance during hemodialysis.

head: Potassium supplement
evidence_text: Potassium supplements are used to correct hypokalaemia; excessive dosing can cause hyperkalaemia.

head: HPV vaccination
evidence_text: Human papillomavirus vaccination substantially reduces the incidence of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia and cervical cancer.

head: Abdominal paracentesis
evidence_text: Large-volume abdominal paracentesis is an effective treatment for tense or refractory ascites in patients with cirrhosis.

head: Inhaled corticosteroids
evidence_text: Local side effects of inhaled corticosteroids include oropharyngeal candidiasis and dysphonia; rinsing the mouth reduces the risk.

head: Anxiety disorder
evidence_text: Generalised anxiety disorder is characterised by excessive worry, restlessness, muscle tension and sleep disturbance.
